configurePresets.name: cuda-release
configurePresets.description: CUDA ICGN + cuFFT FFTCC, no FFTW, no tests. Matches the validated production binary. Override -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES for non-Ada GPUs.

configurePresets.name: cuda-tests
configurePresets.description: cuda-release plus the ctest suite (library_boundaries, output_integrity, cli_interface, parity_unit, version_metadata, oob_rejection, frame_fallback, cache_lifecycle, registry_threads, subpixel_accuracy, zero_texture; 11 tests). Needs a CUDA device to run the tests.

configurePresets.name: cuda-fftw
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA Release + FFTW CPU FFTCC + tests
configurePresets.description: Dual FFTCC backend for --fftcc cpu|gpu A/B runs; also builds opencorr_cli_cpu. Links FFTW (GPL-2.0-or-later): see NOTICE.md before distributing binaries.

configurePresets.name: cpu-only
configurePresets.description: No CUDA toolkit required. FFTW-backed CPU FFTCC plus the CPU ICGN backend, opencorr_cli_cpu, and the CPU ctest suite.

testPresets.name: cuda-release
testPresets.description: The production configuration registers no tests; this preset succeeds instead of failing. Use cuda-tests to actually run them.
